text:
elaine: Quick sync — ACME POC just sent a formal ask: 7yr immutable audit log retention + customer-managed HSM (key separation). They want this covered during a 6‑month POC. Can we surface pricing and whether deal-desk needs to approve a trial exception?
omar: Technical note: we can deliver customer-managed keys on Dedicated/Private. Hosted supports BYOK via KMS but not FIPS HSM isolation in multitenant. For 7yr retention for large logs we should use our cold-archive tier.
jia: POC logistics — they're expecting sample contract language and a line-item cost to include in the SOW by EOD Friday. Also will need an integration window for KMS setup during week 2 of the POC.
omar: Rough rate-card snippet to use in SOW (estimates):
```
HSM (dedicated appliance): $3,500/month (per appliance)
Customer-managed KMS integration (hosted): $600 one-time + $200/month
Audit log hot retention: $0.18/GB/month
Audit log cold/archive: $0.012/GB/month
Immutable retention (legal hold): +10% on storage
```
omar: Those are ballpark — final pricing depends on committed capacity and expected log ingress (GB/day).
kevin: @elaine we can greenlight a 6mo POC promo but deal-desk needs: (1) explicit callout that HSM is a non-refundable provisioning fee if we spin up appliances, (2) minimums for storage and egress for archive, and (3) exec sponsor signoff for any below-floor discount. I need numbers to enter the approval request.
elaine: Understood. Can we use the numbers Omar posted as the starting point for the approval? Also confirm whether infra costs (setup/ops) are separate line items.
omar: Yes — include a one-time setup row for HSM/KMS ops: $1,200. If they want on-prem HSM integration we'll quote as a Professional Services task.
rana: Legal/Compliance: HIPAA covered if they sign our BAA and we run Private or Dedicated with customer-managed keys. For SOC2: standard controls are in place; long retention and immutable logs are fine but add DLP & access review clauses. Also need to confirm retention location (EU vs US) for data residency.
kevin: I'll draft an approval request: we can offer the 6mo POC at the above prices with a trial tag — but exclude any permanent discounts on HSM provisioning. If they want a commitment discount, we'll need a 12mo revenue or usage commit.
jia: Action items: 1) @omar finalize expected GB/day estimate with ACME, 2) @kevin file deal-desk request with the numbers, 3) @rana prepare BAA + retention clause template, 4) @elaine share SOW draft with the rate-card snippet.
infra-bot: Created ticket INF-4567 — "ACME POC: HSM/KMS setup" (assignee: omar).
elaine: Thanks everyone — I'll start SOW draft and loop in ACME legal. Ping me in-thread if any number changes. :thumbsup:
